g.text: Senator Pocock to Treasury, Senate Estimates Feb 2026:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1f2024

g.text: "How do we live in a country, one of the biggest gas exporters

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1f2024

g.text: in the world, and we're getting more tax from beer than PRRT?"
